# Pull Request Template

## Description

_Provide a clear description of the changes introduced by this PR. Include the motivation and any background information._

## Type of Change

- [ ] New feature (adds functionality)
- [ ] Bug fix (corrects a problem)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Refactor / code cleanup
- [ ] Other (please describe)

## Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the existing style guidelines
- [ ] I have performed a self‑review of my code
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works
- [ ] All new and existing tests pass
- [ ] I have updated documentation where necessary
- [ ] I have added appropriate metadata in `meta.json` if this PR adds documentation pages

## Related Issues

_If this PR resolves an open issue, please link it here (e.g., `Closes #123`)._
